description: Run your Lightspeed Retail store from workflows: products, prices and stock, customers, sales, suppliers and stock orders, and start a workflow when a sale, customer, product or stock level changes.

lightspeed_retail_customer_updated_trigg.description: Runs when a customer is added or changes, including their balance after an account sale.

output.customer_code: The code used to claim loyalty.
output.do_not_email: Whether they opted out of email.
output.year_to_date: What they have spent this year.

lightspeed_retail_inventory_changed_trig.description: Runs when a product's stock at an outlet changes: sold, returned, adjusted or received. Only for products whose stock is tracked.

output.average_cost: The average cost of one in stock.
output.current_inventory_level: How many are in stock now.
output.quantity_to_procure: How many are needed for open orders.
output.reorder_point: The level at which to reorder.

parameters.description: Only run for stock changes at this outlet. Leave blank for every outlet.
parameters.name: outlet_id

lightspeed_retail_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is added in Lightspeed Retail.

output.customer_code: The code used to claim loyalty.
output.do_not_email: Whether they opted out of email.
output.year_to_date: What they have spent this year.

lightspeed_retail_product_updated_trigge.description: Runs when a product is added or changes, such as its price.

output.active: in_store: whether it is sold in store.
output.family_id: The id of its product family (use 'Get product' for the name).
output.suppliers: Its suppliers, with their codes and prices.
output.variant_name: Its name, with the variant for a variant product.

lightspeed_retail_register_closed_trigge.description: Runs each time a register is closed at the end of a shift or day.

parameters.description: Only run for registers at this outlet. Leave blank for every outlet.
parameters.name: outlet_id

lightspeed_retail_sale_completed_trigger.description: Runs once for each sale that is completed (fully paid).

output.customer_id: The customer's id, if there is one.
output.line_items: Each item: product (id, name, sku), quantity, pricing and note.
output.payments: Each payment: amount, date and type.
output.totals: price (before tax), price_incl_tax, tax, loyalty and surcharge.
output.user_id: The id of the user who made the sale.

parameters.description: Only run for sales at this outlet. Leave blank for every outlet.
parameters.name: outlet_id

lightspeed_retail_sale_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a sale is made or changes in Lightspeed Retail: paid, parked, voided, or a payment added.

output.customer_id: The customer's id, if there is one.
output.line_items: Each item: product (id, name, sku), quantity, pricing and note.
output.payments: Each payment: amount, date and type.
output.totals: price (before tax), price_incl_tax, tax, loyalty and surcharge.
output.user_id: The id of the user who made the sale.

parameters.description: Only run for sales at this outlet. Leave blank for every outlet.
parameters.name: outlet_id

parameters.description: Only run for sales in this status: closed (completed), parked, pending or voided. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: state

lightspeed_retail_stock_received_trigger.description: Runs when a stock order from a supplier, or a transfer from another outlet, is received.

output.name: Its note.
output.outlet_id: The outlet that received the stock.
output.source_outlet_id: For a transfer, the outlet it came from.
output.supplier_id: For a stock order, the supplier's id.

parameters.description: Only run for stock received at this outlet. Leave blank for every outlet.
parameters.name: outlet_id

parameters.description: SUPPLIER for stock orders or OUTLET for transfers. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: type
